credits.title: Baththa

credits.overview: Set in Perambur, a local Telugu youth falls for an Anglo-Indian girl, sparking a chaotic and humorous clash of cultures between their families.

credits.title: Habeebi

credits.title: Sirai
credits.overview: As he transfers a young convict from prison to court, a police officer learns about the chain of events that led to the young man's conviction for violence.

credits.title: J Baby
credits.overview: Volatile mother leaves family without notice. Sons embark on journey to find her, bringing family drama to light.
